open_public_page.description: Open a locale-prefixed public page on naia.land and return its address and title.

locale.description: Two-letter locale segment such as ko or en. Defaults to ko.

path.description: Path under the locale segment, without a leading slash. Empty means the home page.

returns.description: Object with url and title of the page that was opened.

read_login_form.description: Report which sign-in providers the login card offers and whether a person is required.

returns.description: Object with providers, submitCount, and needsHuman.
